Angel Touch Kitchen

Angel Touch Kitchen is opening a brick-and-mortar restaurant in east Plano to offer Indonesian cuisine.

Owner Yenni Haryanti said the restaurant's slow-cooked beef rendang is one of its best sellers, and other menu items include fried rice, stir-fried noodles and chicken skewers. She said the flavor is made to be approachable to diners while providing an opportunity to discover something new. [...] Opened July 17

Studio 15

A new beauty salon is now open in downtown Plano.

Studio 15 is a full-service salon offering a variety of services for hair, nails, brows and more. Owner Tati Brodsky said the salon is a "one-stop shop" for beauty services.

"We want to create an environment that is accepting of everybody," Brodsky said.

The business is currently in a soft opening period, with a grand opening planned for Oct. 17.

San Martin Bakery

San Martin Bakery opened a new location in Plano.

The Guatemala-based bakery offers a variety of sweet and savory pastries, cakes, specialty breads and more baked goods. San Martin also has a full breakfast, lunch and dinner menu.

The Plano location is the chain's third in Dallas-Fort Worth.

Opened Sept. 28
